description: This file defines a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' for converting raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels. It replaces underscores/hyphens with spaces, collapses whitespace, and applies title casing, preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts raw status codes like 'in_progress' or 'FAILED' into human-readable labels such as 'In Progress' or 'Failed'. Handles null/undefined inputs by returning 'Unknown'.
